slots.name: XLB ETF holding
slots.sentence: Then there are metals plays like Freeport-McMoRan , the third-largest holding in XLB at 6.5% of the ETF, which doesn't really belong in this basket at all, because it's a copper and critical-minerals policy story, an entirely different trade story that is also benefitting from the AI boom.

slots.name: Nucor yearly return
slots.sentence: Still, there is no single trade on that structural element to the business: Nucor's shares are up close to 50% this year, while Cleveland-Cliffs is in negative territory in 2026 due to ongoing balance sheet stress.

slots.name: SLX daily return
slots.sentence: The VanEck Steel ETF ( SLX ) rose 1.6% on Monday alone, while the State Street Materials Select Sector SPDR ( XLB ) hit an intraday all-time high — surpassing its previous all-time record price reached in February — as the metals stocks and other producers rallied.

slots.name: XLB yearly return
slots.sentence: Year-to-date, both ETFs are beating the S&P 500 , with SLX up over 28% and XLB up over 18%, according to Morningstar data as of Aug. 28.
